name: Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) Module
description: Synthesizes and balances the on-chip clock distribution network, including skew signoff for safety-relevant clock domains.

name: Power Management Unit (PMU)
description: Controls voltage rails, power sequencing, and brownout protection for the SoC. On the functional-safety power path.

name: Diagnostic Logging Utility
description: General-purpose logging facility that records diagnostic events to a ring buffer. Not on any safety path.

name: Memory Controller (ECC)
description: DRAM memory controller with ECC. Detects and corrects single-bit errors and flags uncorrectable multi-bit faults into the safety mechanism.

name: Static Timing Analysis (STA) Tool
description: EDA tool used to perform timing signoff. Its output feeds safety-relevant signoff flows, so it is subject to ISO 26262 tool qualification (TCL).

name: Verification Harness
description: Regression and simulation harness used to run testbenches and gate-level simulations.

name: Power Estimation Model
description: Internal model used to predict dynamic and static power. Used for planning, not on any on-chip safety path.

name: Safety Fault-Collection Unit (Watchdog)
description: Collects fault signals from safety mechanisms and triggers the safe-state reaction. Core of the functional-safety concept.

name: Build / Config Management
description: Manages build configurations, revision hashes, and toolchain manifests across build nodes.

name: PLL / Clock Generator (Analog)
description: Analog phase-locked loop that generates functional clocks, including a safety-relevant ASIL-B clock domain.

name: CAN Bus Interface Controller
description: Handles the safety communication channel to other ECUs, including error handling and bus-off recovery.

name: Thermal Monitor / Sensor
description: On-die thermal sensing with plausibility cross-checks. Feeds the safety concept's over-temperature reaction.

name: Firmware OTA Update Manager
description: Manages over-the-air firmware updates using A/B slots and rollback. Not on the functional-safety path.

name: LBIST / Scan Test Controller
description: Logic built-in self-test and scan controller providing diagnostic coverage for the safety island.

name: Requirements Traceability Tool
description: Tool that maintains the requirements-to-verification traceability matrix. Support tooling, not on any safety path.

name: Cache Coherency Unit
description: Maintains coherency across cores, including the safety-critical core. On the functional-safety path.

name: GPIO Controller
description: General-purpose I/O controller for non-safety pins. Not on any safety path.

name: True Random Number Generator (TRNG)
description: Hardware entropy source for cryptographic key generation. Security-relevant but not on the functional-safety path.

name: Sensor Fusion Accelerator
description: Hardware accelerator running Kalman-filter sensor fusion that feeds safety functions.

name: JTAG / Debug-Trace Interface
description: Debug and trace access port used during development. Not on any safety path.
